tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// phyag mchod sdig bshags bsngo ba dang bcas pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs// gcig tu bsdus pa dpal ldan chos kyi rje// gzhan gyi don du skye ba'i skur ston pa// mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rkang gnyis gtso bo thub dbang rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhi ba chags bral nges 'byin dam pa'i chos// tshogs kyi mchog rab 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// dngos su 'byor dang bdag pos ma bzung ba// yid kyis sprul dang bla na med pa yi// mchod sprin rgya mtsho bkod pa'i mtha' klas pas// bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog mchod par bgyi// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi// thog med dus nas nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog spyan sngar bshags// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa yi// dge ba 'di dang dge ba ma lus gzhan// thams cad blo yis gcig tu bsdoms byas nas// sangs rgyas thob phyir yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog rin chen dang*// chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi// bden pa'i mthu yis deng 'dir bde legs shog/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
